notes: Security-audit competency: read Python service source, recognize five vulnerability patterns, and map each to the exact CWE identifier (CWE-78/89/502/327/798). Delivered as a reusable line-based scanner plus the report on the visible fixture. Hidden cases probe generality: parameterized SQL, literal-only commands, bytes-literal pickle, Loader=yaml.SafeLoader, environment-sourced credentials, commented-out decoys, strong hashes, dotted attribute assignment, empty findings list, and two sql-injection/weak-hash repeats per file. Any wrong/missing CWE id, wrong line, wrong rule, or a decoy reported fails the audit. Rubric nonzero for reasoning_depth (five interlocking rules), adversarial_inputs and hidden_case_generalization (decoy-dense hidden sources), quantitative_correctness (exact report structure).
